title: Builder Ledger record
description: One verified observation of one builder incentive offer at one community on one date. Records live in dated snapshot directories (northfwliving-data/builder-ledger/<YYYY-MM-DD>/records.json) and are append-only: a later observation of the same offer is a NEW record in a NEW snapshot, never an edit of an old one. Every field except builder, source, source_url and verified_date may be null, and null always means 'unknown' — never guess, never invent an expiration.

builder.description: Builder name as published by the builder.

community.description: Community/subdivision the offer applies to; null if builder-wide or unknown.

offer_summary.description: Plain-English one-liner of the advertised offer, quoting the builder's own wording where possible.

advertised_rate.description: Advertised interest rate in percent (e.g. 4.99). Null if the offer is not a rate offer or the rate is unpublished.

rate_conditions.description: Published conditions on the rate: preferred lender, select inventory, lock length, etc.

closing_cost_credit.description: Dollar amount of advertised closing-cost credit.

flex_cash.description: Dollar amount of advertised flexible credit.

eligible_inventory.description: Published scope: e.g. 'select quick move-in homes', specific plans/phases.

effective_date.description: Date the offer took effect, if published.

expiration_date.description: Published expiration. If the builder does not publish one, this stays null and notes should say 'expiration unpublished'.

source.description: Where the offer was observed. Official builder website/community page preferred; third-party summaries are not acceptable when an official source exists.

verified_date.description: Date this record was checked against the source.

confidence.description: 'verified' = read from the official builder source on verified_date.

previous_value.description: Optional pointer/summary of what the same offer looked like in the prior snapshot, to make direction-of-change auditable.
